module.purpose: Provides shared Zod validation schemas, inferred TypeScript types, enums, and utility functions for scheduling, booking, event configuration, organization metadata, routing forms, and related API data.
module.summary: This module centralizes runtime validation and static typing for core scheduling-platform data. It defines schemas for bookings, recurring events, event metadata, onboarding, billing, recordings, routing forms, custom fields, authentication inputs, and service-account credentials. It also supplies reusable email, password, date, URL, and numeric validation, plus strongly typed object-entry utilities and schema transformations. Several definitions preserve compatibility with existing library exports and Prisma-managed event properties.
module.businessContext:
Supports appointment scheduling, booking administration, organization onboarding, routing forms, billing metadata, and integrations.
Validation failures can reject bookings, corrupt configuration, weaken signup safeguards, or break external API workflows.

Booking cancellation callers provide at least one truthy id or uid.

units.source:
export const EditableSchema = z.enum([
  "system", // Can't be deleted, can't be hidden, name can't be edited, can't be marked optional
  "system-but-optional", // Can't be deleted. Name can't be edited. But can be hidden or be marked optional
  "system-but-hidden", // Can't be deleted, name can't be edited, will be shown
  "user", // Fully editable
  "user-readonly", // All fields are readOnly.
]);
